{{Quote|Dr. Maldien says that we may have to resort to more unorthodox means.|A researcher|<ref name="SWG:CMRM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Researching Manipulation|Corellia}}</ref>}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Maldien''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You! How did you get in here? You have no right to be here!|Maldien, to a spacer|<ref name="Galactic Hunters">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Mad Zoo promotional scenario}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Doctor Maldien was based in a [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|laboratory]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:CMTHD" /> There, he conducted illegal and highly dangerous genetic experiments, utilizing bio-engineering to create monsters. For instance, the scientist was crossing DNA between aggressive creatures and passive members of the same genus in order to create powerful and intelligent fighting beasts.<ref name="SWG:CMRM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the lab was finally discovered by the [[Corellian Security Force]]. Corsec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the lab. The spacer killed Doctor Maldien,<ref name="SWG:CMTHD" /> and all engineered creatures,<ref name="SWG:CMCOtZ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Clear Out the Zoo|Corellia}}</ref> and eventually destroyed all the research data collected.<ref name="SWG:CMStD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Shut them Down|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Maldien appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CMTHD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Maldien was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
